75368:
**This is the final boss for Sora's side of the story.**

The first phase of the fight, Xemnas will retreat to the other side of the fighting area and throwing buildings at you. Don't try to attack during this sequence, just dodge.

Similar to the Rinzler fight in The Grid, Xemnas is a blur of teleporting and flurried melee attacks. You likely won't have opportunities for Keyblade combos or commands. Focus on guarding and using Counter Rush whenever Xemnas is close.

Halfway through his health, Xemnas will retreat and throw buildings at you again. This time, however, the buildings will knock the arena from under you. Use the prompted Reality Shift to temporarily knock out Xemnas, and *quickly* use a rail to get close and pummel him with everything you have. Once he recovers, he'll be impossible to stagger and even more aggressive. So utilize that opportunity as much as you can.

Xemnas will then return to his teleporting and barrage melee attacks. Be vigilant about guarding and countering, and slowly you will whittle down the rest of his health.
